faqs.q: Sec. 46-61. - Purchase of bonds by authority.
faqs.a:
The authority has power, out of any funds available therefor, to purchase any bonds
               issued by it at a price not more than the principal amount thereof and the accrued
               interest. All bonds so purchased shall be cancelled. This section shall not apply
               to the redemption of bonds.
(Code 1981, § 14-30; Ord. No. 1248, § 13(4), 6-16-1975)
State Law reference—
Similar provisions, C.R.S. § 29-4-215(4).
